issue_request: FHIR-40720 is Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked to keep the extension and code system, deprecate the codesystem code, add a valueset code with definition 'The parameter was provided in the value set definition.', change the extension description to 'Allows a server to assert the source of a parameter used in the $expand.', and make no changes to the value set definition.

additional_context: Terminology Infrastructure minutes and Jira comments show the work group narrowed the earlier clarity discussion to the code system and extension wording rather than changing the value set definition. Zulip history explains the original server/default use case and the 2023 value set extension review that led to this tracker. The Extension Pack is the owning repository for the current artifacts.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core source was changed because editing core would affect only OID/history material, not the authoritative extension definitions.
